summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing UK MAR Article 19 notifications of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities. Co-Chief Executive Asia and Middle East David Liao acquired 4,504 ordinary shares at 15.19792 pence per share, totaling £68,451.43, and Chief Executive International Wealth and Premier Banking Barry O'Byrne acquired 9 shares totaling £136.78. Both acquisitions occurred on 25 September 2026 on the London Stock Exchange Main Market via automatic reinvestment of HSBC's second interim dividend for 2026. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are present; this is a disclosure-only filing.
